Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment 
inspection I1, which must be performed on a weekly bases as indicated by W1 in the 
title block.
The first draft is 
initiated by eng. Sherif Mahrous Omar tested by eng. Nafad Kamel Mahmoud, 
revised by quality engineer Gamal Abd Elwahab, accepted by technical expert eng. 
Hassan Elbehiry and approved by eng. Mohamed Gamal Diab Head sector of El-Kuriemat 
power station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
